en: A vintage monochrome postcard view of a canal or river lined with ornate late‑19th‑century brick buildings on the left bank and a row of trees on the right bank. A couple of moored boats sit in the foreground, and a small bridge or jetty extends from the left bank. The sky is light and cloudy. Printed captions in Dutch identify the scene and photographer, and there is a handwritten year at the bottom.
